column1: # ASR reference measurements, MLX engine. One machine, one OS, one set of dependency versions.
# Machine: Apple M5 (24 GB), macOS 26.6.2, Swift 6.2, speech built -c release,
# speech-mlx built Release through xcodebuild, mlx-audio-swift 0.1.3, mlx-swift 0.31.6,
# helper buffer pool bounded at 512 MB (its default). Produced by `speech eval --report`.
# Companion to measurements-2026-09-05.tsv, which holds the apple, fluid and ggml rows:
# same corpora, same full splits, same scorer, same peak_memory_bytes instrument, so a
# cell here is directly comparable to a cell there.
# THESE ROWS ARE MEASURED, NOT OFFERED. Every one of them is matched or beaten by a ggml
# row built from the same weights, at about a third of the memory, so stage 4B's gate
# fails and the MLX engine stays as an instrument. The numbers are kept so that the next
# run, when mlx-audio-swift moves, is a comparison rather than a fresh start.
# These are a starting reference point, not the truth on any other machine. Speech.app
# re-measures locally; see the benchmarking section of the development plan.
